property_summary: For any callee address that reverts when called, C.forward propagates that failure (i.e., calling forward to a reverting callee always causes forward to revert), but the mutant that replaces require(_s) with require(true) allows forward to succeed despite callee revert.
change_summary: Replace the require(_s) with require(true) so the function never reverts based on the call result, allowing forward to succeed even if the callee fails.
